about_the_game:
MousePlay - One-click automatic clicking artifact

Real-time recording & playback | Smart clicker | Infinite creative gameplay possibilities!

Feature highlights:

✔ Accurate recording: Real-time capture of mouse movement trajectory and click actions, perfectly reproduce your operation!

✔ Smart playback: One-click playback of recorded content, support looping, accurate to milliseconds control!

✔ Super clicker: Can click and click at milliseconds frequency, freeing your hands!

✔ Creative gameplay:

Game macro: Record complex operations and release combos with one click!

Automated script: Repetitive work? Leave it to MousePlay!

Painting assistance: Record trajectory and automatically generate smooth lines!

Hang-up artifact: Automatically click, brush resources, hang-up upgrade!

Applicable scenarios:

Gamers: Automatically brush monsters, combo macros, hang-up tasks

Office experts: Automate repeated click operations to improve efficiency

Easy to use, powerful functions!

Support shortcut key control (one-click start/stop)

Unleash the potential of your mouse and explore endless possibilities!

Download MousePlay now and experience a new level of automation!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 1.66 GHz Intel i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 1024 MB RAM
  • Graphics: HD Graphics 4000 or above
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10, Windows 11
  • Processor: 2.0 GHz Intel i7 or equivalent
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 660, AMD HD7870, 2 GB VRAM or above
  • Storage: 1024 MB available space
